text:
alex: Anyone else seeing pods bounce between gpu-pool-a and general-pool after the cluster autoscaler scaled down? Started ~5:10am UTC.

maria: yep saw that. symptoms: pods Pending until node gets re-created, then they schedule on wrong pool (no GPU). Probably toleration/affinity mismatch.

sam: can you paste pod yaml? suspect preferredDuringScheduling didn't match, fallback to default routing.

alex: paste:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: worker-bert-0
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: "redwood/gpu"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: "kubernetes.io/gpu"
            operator: In
            values: ["nvidia"]
```

danielle: hmm toleration key on node is `redwood/gpu`. nodes have taint `redwood/gpu=true:NoSchedule`? check `kubectl describe node`.

alex: nodes show taint `redwood/gpu:NoSchedule` (missing value). so pods have value=true which won't match.

ryan: aha value mismatch. scheduler treats missing value as empty string; your operator=Equal will fail. Change pod toleration to operator: Exists or remove value.

sam: +1. Alternatively change node taint to include value `true` but that is riskier.

maria: related: autoscaler scaled down GPU nodes aggressively because scale-down delay is 10m and pods got rescheduled to non-gpu. We should bump `scaleDownUnneededTime` for gpu nodegroup.

alex: quick fix applied: updated pod template to toleration operator: Exists and preferredDuringSchedulingAdded weight to favor gpu nodes. Will monitor.

devops-bot: deploy alex/worker -> v2 successful :white_check_mark: (rolling)

alex: after change, new pods stuck waiting for GPUs for ~30s then schedule correctly onto gpu-pool. logs show scheduler predicate: NodeAffinity matched, Tolerations matched.

danielle: follow-ups: add a lint rule to CI to catch toleration key/value mismatches (we already have an e2e failure flake). Also add alert when pods with label gpu=true schedule on non-gpu nodes for >1m.

ryan: created github issue #1287 for autoscaler tuning + linter.

maria: thanks all, closing thread unless new regressions. @oncall if you see flapping please ping.
